calls.price_at_call: ~25% off its highs (52-wk range $40-$105, price not stated)
calls.thesis: BUY (first tracked) — guest Ross Given: Tempus AI uses AI on tumour-test data to help doctors pick the best cancer treatment, and drug companies rent that data back, so it gets paid at both ends; Q3 sales ~$400m, up 23%, forecast raised. 'Just buy this, give it some room, trailing a stop 15-20%.'
calls.base_case: Data deals ($500-600m inked this year) keep compounding as drug companies rent the library.
calls.bull_case: A $14bn company that 'could easily be a $140bn company' as AI drug design scales.
calls.bear_case: Moves ~8% high-to-low on an average day; valuation hard to pin down while growth is lumpy.
